submitted.rationale: XRD shows one fluorite-type Y–Sb–O phase all along the line, with peaks at Q ≈ 2.79, 3.22, 4.55 and 5.33. The Y-rich end has an extra weak peak at Q ≈ 2.06, from a second phase. Both Y and Sb oxides have wide band gaps, so little response was expected under 2.4 eV light. All three EQE values were close to zero (below 0.002%). Index 8 (Sb 0.12, from the Y-rich two-phase region) was the only positive one, at 0.0008%.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE -0.00035%, effectively zero, at the Sb-rich end in the single fluorite phase
Measured EQE -0.0012%, effectively zero, in the middle of the single fluorite phase
